plan.title: Three-way split award and approval refusal

steps.note: Open the prepared closed event's Master QCS, as required for this state.
Enable partial awarding so the available two-vendor prepared event can be split.
Enable eRFX project support required by the case configuration.
Open the awarding screen for the closed event.
Allocate 4 units to the second prepared bidder, corresponding to the requested split's B portion.
Allocate the remaining 6 units to the first prepared bidder so the available two-vendor allocation totals 10 units.
Verify that both available vendors are selected and the available split totals 4 × 90 plus 6 × 100 = 960.
Create the award proposal from the completed available allocation.
Verify that the proposal page opened.
Fill mandatory proposal fields before submitting it.
Submit the proposal so the approval state can be reached.
Verify the submitted proposal remains on the proposal workflow.
